mapper.select: select selection.task_id, selection.device_satellite_id, selection.telemetry_code, selection.selection_type, selection.target_id, rule_config.telemetry_name, device.type as device_satellite_type from processed_telemetry_filter_selection selection inner join device_satellite device on device.id = selection.device_satellite_id and device.task_id = selection.task_id and device.is_deleted = 0 inner join telemetry_parse_rule_config rule_config on rule_config.task_id = selection.task_id and rule_config.device_satellite_id = selection.device_satellite_id and rule_config.telemetry_code = selection.telemetry_code and rule_config.is_deleted = 0 where selection.task_id = #{taskId} and selection.is_deleted = 0 and selection.selection_type = #{selectionType} and selection.target_id = #{targetId} order by selection.device_satellite_id, selection.telemetry_code

select task_id, device_satellite_id, telemetry_code, selection_type, target_id from processed_telemetry_filter_selection where task_id = #{taskId} and device_satellite_id = #{deviceSatelliteId} and is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: insert into processed_telemetry_filter_selection (task_id, device_satellite_id, telemetry_code, selection_type, target_id, is_deleted) values (#{taskId}, #{deviceSatelliteId}, #{telemetryCode}, #{selectionType}, #{targetId}, #{deleted}) on conflict (task_id, selection_type, target_id, device_satellite_id, telemetry_code) do update set is_deleted = excluded.is_deleted, update_time = current_timestamp
mapper.update: update processed_telemetry_filter_selection set is_deleted = 1, update_time = current_timestamp where task_id = #{taskId} and device_satellite_id = #{deviceSatelliteId} and telemetry_code = #{telemetryCode} and is_deleted = 0

update processed_telemetry_filter_selection selection set is_deleted = 1, update_time = current_timestamp where selection.task_id = #{taskId} and selection.is_deleted = 0 and selection.device_satellite_id in ( select id from device_satellite where task_id = #{taskId} and type = #{type} ) and not exists ( select 1 from telemetry_parse_rule_config rule_config where rule_config.task_id = selection.task_id and rule_config.device_satellite_id = selection.device_satellite_id and rule_config.telemetry_code = selection.telemetry_code and rule_config.is_deleted = 0 )
